entities.summary: Jerime Anthony Anderson is an American professional basketball player for Astros de Jalisco of the Circuito de Baloncesto de la Costa del Pacífico (CIBACOPA). He usually plays as point guard. Anderson played college basketball with the UCLA Bruins.
